beforeFix.finding: Twenty search updates and a form-error update in a 500-line pickup caused a widget rewrite before any new durable change.

scope: The bound app coordinator keeps the existing widget file through search and form errors. Checking a line refreshes the existing route, starting a new pickup changes the route, and backgrounding clears it. The tests use isolated app stores with denied notification scheduling. Rendered typing latency, OS widget reload timing and physical-device performance remain separate.
